title: Short-period frequency / acceleration sensitivity (Figure 3, Category C): Level 1, Category C

ruleset.name: MIL-F-8785C
ruleset.basis: Class IV; bare airframe; the classical modes of the linear model are the equivalent system (3.1.12)

scale_basis: the magnitude of the lower bound

conditions.search: grid, optional one-step local refinement around the critical point

status_policy.rule: No status other than OK can improve a verdict (FC-702); a DIVERGENT point fails every Level; no usable point gives NOT_ASSESSABLE (FC-701)

notes: CAP = omega_nsp^2/(n/alpha), omega in rad/s, n/alpha in g/rad. Boundaries are straight lines of constant omega^2/(n/alpha) on log-log paper, labeled on the figure. Values of n/alpha outside the plotted range (1-100 g/rad) are defined by straight-line extensions. Equivalent-system parameters apply (3.1.12). Figure 3. Level 3 boundary for n/alpha < 1.0 also defined by straight-line extension. May be relaxed (lower bounds on omega and n/alpha) if direct normal-force control is provided and approved.
